title: 外倾宽点对压
description: 木版画用宽大对压手点和低脚点描绘紧凑稳定的浅外倾姿态。

art_direction.medium: hand-painted oil illustration with restrained impasto
art_direction.scene: Create an original woodcut-style illustration of a fictional fully clothed adult maintaining low compression between two broad opposing holds on a shallow overhang. Both shoes stay engaged on positive footholds only a small step above thick continuous crash mats, while the hips shift gently toward the weighted leg. The hands face naturally toward each other and the torso remains compact. Show the whole adult in a wide oblique view with the wall angle and clear landing area visible. Carved indigo contours, ivory grain, and limited vermilion hold accents create strong original shapes. No lettering, brands, high exposure, leaps, swinging feet, or extreme muscle exaggeration.
